Primary CTA Button
role: Hero email capture submit, section CTAs
description: Background #00c27a, color #000000, border #000000 1px solid, border-radius 8px, padding 9px 52px 9px 16px (asymmetric — wide right for icon/arrow). ABC Social 500, 14-16px. The black border on a green button is unconventional — it adds weight and keeps jade from floating.

name: Outlined Black Button
description: Background transparent, color #000000, border #000000 1px solid, border-radius 8px, padding 8px 16px. ABC Social 500. Sits beside CTA buttons as the 'no-commitment' option.

name: Ghost White Button
description: Background transparent, color #ffffff, border #ffffff 1px solid, border-radius 0px, padding 0. Zero radius and zero padding — these appear as inline underlined-style links styled as ghost buttons in the hero, not pill or block shapes.

name: Large Filled Grey Button
role: Feature navigation tabs, section-level action buttons
description: Background #f3f3f3, color #000000, no border, border-radius 8px, padding 23px 44px. ABC Social 500 at 16px. Large padding (23px vertical) creates a tall, substantial button used for primary section navigation choices.

name: Email Input Field
description: Background #000000, color #ffffff, border #4f5457 1px solid, border-radius 8px, padding 8px 16px. Dark input on dark background — distinguishable only by the #4f5457 border. Placeholder text in #808080.

name: Blog Badge
description: Background #d5f8e0, color #007b3b, border-radius 26px, padding 2px 16px 1px 16px. ABC Social 500 at 12px. The 26px radius creates a true pill. Leaf green background with forest text — the only colored text element in the body sections.

name: Content Card — Large Rounded
description: Background #ffffff, border-radius 24px, no border, shadow rgba(0,0,0,0.08) 0px 4px 4px 0px. Padding 0 (image fills top, text below with internal padding). The 24px radius softens what is otherwise a sharp-edged system — cards are the site's only round affordance.

name: Content Card — Ash Fill
description: Background #eeeeee, border-radius 7-8px, no border, no shadow. Padding 40px 5-6px. The extreme vertical padding with minimal horizontal padding creates a tall narrow container used for icon-led feature columns.

name: Product UI Card
description: Background #ffffff, border-radius 24px, no box-shadow, full-bleed image content inside. Floated over the dark hero section to create contrast between the product and the marketing context.

name: AI Chat Widget
description: Background #ffffff, border-radius 16px, shadow rgba(11,41,70,0.32) 0px 0px 1px 0px, rgba(42,82,121,0.08) 0px 24px 20px 0px. Contains avatar, name, role label, conversation text, CTA button (#00c27a, 8px radius), and text input. The blue-tinted shadow (rgba(11,41,70)) is the only non-monochrome shadow in the system.

name: Section Eyebrow Label
role: Pre-heading category labels above section titles
description: Color #8c8c8c or #000000, ABC Social 500 at 11px, letter-spacing +0.175em, uppercase transform. No background, no border. Acts as a whispered section tag before the STK Bureau headline drops.

name: Logo Bar — Trusted Brands
description: White or light-grey background strip, grayscale brand logos (Microsoft, IBM, etc.) at medium opacity. ABC Social 500 at 11px uppercase label 'TRUSTED BY BRANDS AROUND THE WORLD' at +0.175em tracking centered above. No border, no card, flush horizontal scroll.
